about: Factory calibration records for the Dubai test station 'aqms-monitor'. Only values printed on Alphasense factory calibration sheets go here. Today only the NH3 sheet exists. H2S and VOC have no record yet, so Terra shows 'calibration missing' for them until their factory sheets are entered (see calibration_template_to_fill.json). Add a NEW record to change anything; never edit an old one.

records.notes: From the factory sheet: WE zero 328 mV; sensitivity 73.28 nA/ppm x 0.8 mV/nA (ISB gain) = 58.624 mV/ppm. NH3 (ppm) = (A0 mV - 328) / 58.624. valid_from is the date this record was first used on the test station.
